item.title: Backstreet Boys Recall Drake Saying His First Kiss Was to Their Song, Choose Between *NSYNC & O-Town
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our show, where we dive into the world of music and entertainment. Today, we're talking about the one and only Backstreet Boys. The group recently sat down with Billboard to chat about their experiences, and we've got some highlights to share with you.
[Music transitions to a conversation-style tone]
Host: You might be surprised to learn that the Backstreet Boys have a special connection with rapper Drake. According to the group, Drake revealed that his first kiss was to one of their songs. This led to a memorable moment when Drake joined the Backstreet Boys on stage in Toronto to perform "I Want It That Way".
[Short music clip of "I Want It That Way"]
Host: But that's not all. The group also talked about their upcoming residency in Las Vegas, where they'll be celebrating over 25 years of their iconic album Millennium. As AJ McLean explained, "We're taking people on a journey, taking people down memory lane... it's a lot to take in."
[Short music clip of Millennium-era music]
Host: And, in a fun twist, the Backstreet Boys were asked to choose between *NSYNC and O-Town in a game of "This or That". The answers were divided, with Nick Carter choosing O-Town, while AJ McLean and Howie D opted for *NSYNC.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today's episode. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one! [Outro music continues to play]
